name: Dive Admin
author: awcode

sections.description:
DiveAdmin is an online software solution for dive schools and dive centers.

Features include:

  • Customer and diver management
  • Lead & booking management
  • Daily trip planning and organisation
  • Digital & printable boat lists
  • Digital forms for liability, medical etc. E-signed forms, no more paperwork!
  • Agent booking platform
  • Billing & POS System
  • Equipment management
  • Supports PADI, SSI and other dive certification organisations
  • and lots more….

This plugin lets you connect your DiveAdmin account with your WordPress website.

Once connected you can:

  • Sync woocommerce sales into DiveAdmin Leads
  • Add a DiveAdmin lead form to your website

Please note:
Use of this plugin requires an active account with diveadmin.com
The plugin will send data about new leads to your diveadmin account.
Diveadmin accounts are subject to their terms and privacy policies.
sections.installation:
1. Unzip dive-admin.php
  2. Upload the dive-admi folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
